steps.en: Install it on the machine where your coding CLI is already logged in
steps.zh: 装在你的 coding CLI 已经登录好的那台机器上

steps.en: Starts a local server and discovers every existing session and project by itself
steps.zh: 起一个本地服务，自己发现全部已有会话和项目

steps.en: Turn on the tools you want — every one is disabled until you do
steps.zh: 逐个打开你要的工具——不动手就全是关的

steps.en: Brings the terminal, the file tree and the git diff into the browser over a socket
steps.zh: 把终端、文件树、git diff 通过 socket 接进浏览器

steps.en: From your phone, open a running session, send a follow-up or review its diff
steps.zh: 在手机上打开一个正跑着的会话，追加指令或审它的 diff

steps.en: Runs the turn through the local CLI and writes back to that CLI's own on-disk state
steps.zh: 用本机 CLI 跑这一轮，写回该 CLI 自己的磁盘状态

value.en: The agent already on your workstation becomes reachable from any device, on its own sessions
value.zh: 工位上那个 agent 变成任何设备都能开的，且开的是它自己的会话

sources: README 'Self-Hosted (Open source) > npm' (npx @cloudcli-ai/cloudcli, or npm install -g @cloudcli-ai/cloudcli then `cloudcli`; requires Node.js v22+)
README 'Open http://localhost:3001 — all your existing sessions are discovered automatically.'
README 'Security & Tools Configuration' (all Claude Code tools are disabled by default; enable selectively via the gear icon / Tools Settings, preferences saved locally)
README 'Features' and page Tech stack (Node/Express with node-pty for real PTYs, `ws` WebSocket data plane, CodeMirror editor, xterm.js terminals, git diff surfaces)
README intro (fronts the locally installed Claude Code / Codex / Cursor CLI agents and their on-disk state rather than re-implementing them)
